info.title: Amana Backend API
info.description:
OpenAPI coverage for the live Amana backend routes under `backend/src/routes`.

Authentication flow:
1. Call `POST /auth/challenge` with a Stellar public key.
2. Sign the returned challenge with the wallet.
3. Exchange the signature at `POST /auth/verify` for a bearer token.
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to protected endpoints.

JWT semantics enforced by middleware:
- `iss` must match `JWT_ISSUER` (default `amana`)
- `aud` must match `JWT_AUDIENCE` (default `amana-api`)
- `jti` is required and checked against the revocation denylist
  (revoked tokens are rejected — replay protection)
- `iat` (issued-at) must be present and in the past
- `exp` (expires-at) is enforced: expired tokens are rejected
  (default TTL: 86400 s / 24 h, configurable via `JWT_EXPIRES_IN`)
- `nbf` (not-before) must be present and not be in the future
- Tokens signed with algorithms other than HS256 are rejected

Error code references in operation descriptions map to backend `ErrorCode` values in
`backend/src/errors/errorCodes.ts`. Some route handlers still emit legacy `{ error }`
payloads while centralized validation/runtime failures return `{ code, message, details }`.

# API Versioning

The public API is served on two lanes that share identical behaviour:

- **Versioned lane (current):** all paths below under the `api/v1` URL prefix,
  e.g. `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
- **Legacy alias (deprecated):** the same paths without a version prefix, e.g.
  `POST /auth/login`. Served for backwards compatibility with clients that have
  not yet moved to `/api/v1`.

The legacy alias sends `Deprecation: true` and a `Sunset` header on every response;
client SDKs target `/api/v1`. Admin (`/admin`, `/api/admin`) and health (`/health`)
routes are internal/infra and are intentionally unversioned — they are out of scope
for the versioning policy in `docs/api-versioning.md`.

code.description:
Error code classifying the failure type. Submission error codes:
- `SUBMISSION_VALIDATION_ERROR`: Malformed transaction XDR (400)
- `SUBMISSION_NETWORK_ERROR`: Network timeout, connection refused, or rate limiting (429/502/503/504)
- `SUBMISSION_CONTRACT_ERROR`: Smart contract rejected the transaction (404/502)
- `SUBMISSION_AUTHORIZATION_ERROR`: Transaction was not authorized (401/403)

StreamStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a vested token stream. ACTIVE and SUSPENDED are live
states an admin may terminate from; TERMINATED and COMPLETED are terminal.

reason.description: Operator-supplied reason, stored on the stream and in the admin audit log.

unsignedTxXdr.description:
Base64 unsigned Soroban transaction XDR for the on-chain terminate
call. When present it is signed with the admin key and returned as
`signedTxXdr`; when absent only the backend transition is performed.

terminatedBy.description: Wallet address of the admin who terminated the stream.

signedTxXdr.description: Signed transaction XDR; null when no unsigned XDR was supplied.

unclaimed.description: Unclaimed vested amount at the moment of termination.

reversible.description: Always false — termination cannot be undone.

VestingState.description:
Derived from `claimed` vs. `totalVested` — independent of the stream's
lifecycle `status`, since e.g. a SUSPENDED stream may already be
fully vested.

amount.description: Requested clawback amount as a positive integer string.

remainingVested.description: The stream's actual unclaimed vested balance before this clawback.

reason.description: Operator-supplied reason for the maintenance lock.

locked.description: Always true for a successful lock.

lockedBy.description: Wallet address of the admin who locked the stream.

reason.description: Optional note for the unlock action.

locked.description: Always false for a successful unlock.

unlockedBy.description: Wallet address of the admin who unlocked the stream.

signedChallenge.description: Base64url wallet signature for the issued challenge.

token.description: JWT bearer token for subsequent API calls.

ManifestView.description:
Returned shape depends on caller role.
- Seller views include full manifest fields.
- Buyer views mask driver identity fields.
- Mediator/admin views expose hashed identity values.

UnauthorizedError.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or semantically invalid bearer token.

ForbiddenError.description: Authenticated caller is not allowed to perform the action.

get.description:
Retrieve admin audit log entries, newest first. Uses opaque
cursor-based pagination (`cursor` / `pageInfo.nextCursor`), which
stays stable under concurrent inserts. The legacy `page`/`limit`
offset params are still accepted for backward compatibility — the
response then includes a `Warning` header and a `pagination` object
instead of `pageInfo` — but new clients should use `cursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `pageInfo.nextCursor`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Legacy offset pagination. Ignored when `cursor` is present.

200.description: Successfully retrieved admin audit log entries.

get.description: Get active feature flags and system runtime toggles for administrative controls.

Paginated list of vested token streams, newest first. Supports
filtering by lifecycle `status`, derived `vestingState` (how much of
the stream has actually vested, independent of lifecycle status),
and `adminTag` (operator-assigned label). Backs the admin stream
list UI that the clawback confirmation flow (#56, #57) is launched
from.

Retrieve cached stream state for admin queries. Returns cached result
when fresh, otherwise fetches from DB and caches it.

Error code references: `NOT_FOUND` (unknown stream), `VALIDATION_ERROR` (invalid stream ID format).

post.summary: Preview a stream clawback before execution
post.description:
Validates a requested clawback amount against the stream's actual
remaining vested (unclaimed) balance and returns the resulting
post-clawback balance, without performing the clawback. Powers the
admin confirmation modal (#56) and client-side amount validation
(#57) — the frontend calls this before letting the operator confirm.

Concurrent clawback requests against the same stream are serialized;
a request against a stream with a clawback already in flight gets
`409`. All routes in this section return `404` when the
`ADMIN_ROUTES_ENABLED` feature flag is off.

Error code references: `NOT_FOUND` (unknown stream),
`CLAWBACK_INVALID_AMOUNT` (zero/negative amount),
`CLAWBACK_TOO_LARGE` (amount exceeds `remainingVested`),
`DOMAIN_ERROR` (clawback already in progress for this stream).

400.description: Invalid stream ID format, invalid amount, or amount exceeds the remaining vested balance.

409.description: A clawback is already in progress for this stream.

post.summary: Terminate a stream (admin only)
post.description:
Permanently terminates a vested token stream. Admin only.

The stream's state is validated before anything is signed or written:
an unknown stream is a `404`, and a stream already in a terminal state
(`TERMINATED`, `COMPLETED`) is a `409` rather than a silent no-op, so a
double-submit is visible to the operator instead of producing a second
audit record for one real action.

Supplying `unsignedTxXdr` signs the on-chain terminate call with the
configured admin key and returns the signed XDR for submission; the
resulting on-chain event is ingested by the event listener. Omitting it
performs the backend state transition only. Every successful
termination writes an `AdminActionAudit` record (`STREAM_TERMINATE`).

Termination is irreversible — `reversible` is always `false`.
Error code references: `NOT_FOUND`, `DOMAIN_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

400.description: Invalid stream ID format or validation error.

409.description: Stream is not in a state that can be terminated, or the stream is locked for maintenance.

post.summary: Lock a stream for maintenance (admin only)
post.description:
Marks a stream as locked for operational maintenance. Idempotent —
locking an already-locked stream returns 200 without changing state.

Locked streams reject other admin mutations (suspend, resume,
terminate, clawback) with `409 Conflict` until unlocked.
User-facing operations are unaffected.

Every successful lock writes an `AdminActionAudit` record
(`STREAM_LOCK`). Error code references: `NOT_FOUND`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

400.description: Invalid stream ID format or validation error.

post.summary: Unlock a previously locked stream (admin only)
post.description:
Removes the maintenance lock from a stream. Idempotent — unlocking an
already-unlocked stream returns 200 without changing state.

Every successful unlock writes an `AdminActionAudit` record
(`STREAM_UNLOCK`). Error code references: `NOT_FOUND`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

400.description: Invalid stream ID format or validation error.

post.summary: Reconcile a stream's backend state against on-chain events
post.description:
Compares a stream's backend database record against ingested on-chain
contract events (StreamClawbackEvent, ProcessedEvent) and admin audit
actions, returning a structured reconciliation result.

Fields compared:
- `pendingClawback`: DB value vs sum of on-chain StreamClawbackEvent amounts
- `unclaimed`: computed (totalVested - claimed - onChainClawbacks) vs DB value
- `status`: checks if an admin terminate audit record exists but the stream is still live
- `claimed`: flags when on-chain clawbacks exist but claimed is zero

The response includes a snapshot of the current backend state and an
on-chain summary so the operator can see both sides at a glance.
Admin only. No request body required.
Error code references: `NOT_FOUND`.

200.description: Reconciliation completed — check `consistent` field for result.

get.summary: Current network fee stats plus a congestion-buffered recommendation
get.description:
Proxies Horizon's fee-stats endpoint and adds a `recommended` block
(issue #184). The recommendation takes a configurable percentile of
recent `fee_charged`, applies a safety multiplier that increases when
the network looks congested (`ledger_capacity_usage` high, or the
percentile fee far above the base fee), and clamps the result to
`[STELLAR_FEE_MIN_STROOPS, STELLAR_FEE_MAX_STROOPS]`.

Raw Horizon fields (`feeCharged`, `maxFee`, `ledger`,
`lastLedgerBaseFee`) are unchanged for backward compatibility.

502.description: Horizon is unreachable or returned an error.

Supported MIME types: `video/mp4`, `video/webm`.
Maximum file size: 50 MB.
Supports optional `Idempotency-Key`.

get.summary: Inspect the caller's parsed admin JWT claims
get.description:
Diagnostic endpoint returning the sanitized JWT claims the backend
parsed from the caller's bearer token (wallet address, token id,
issuer/audience, issued/expiry timestamps), so an admin can verify
exactly what the server sees without decoding the token by hand.
Raw fields not meaningful to display (`sub`, `nbf`) are omitted.
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`.

post.summary: Register a mediator on the escrow contract
post.description:
Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction that adds `mediatorAddress` to the
on-chain mediator registry (`add_mediator`), previously only doable via the
`soroban contract invoke` CLI. Admin-only; the caller's wallet is the
transaction source/signer. As with other admin transaction endpoints, the
backend never holds a signing key — the caller signs and submits the
returned XDR themselves.
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

mediatorAddress.description: Stellar public key to register as a mediator.

delete.summary: Revoke a mediator on the escrow contract
delete.description:
Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction that removes `address` from the
on-chain mediator registry (`remove_mediator`). Admin-only; the caller's
wallet is the transaction source/signer.
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Stellar public key to remove from the mediator registry.

patch.summary: Update the escrow contract platform fee rate
patch.description:
Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction that updates the platform fee
(`update_fee_bps`). The contract itself enforces the fee stays within its
configured [MIN_FEE_BPS, MAX_FEE_BPS] bounds; this endpoint additionally
rejects out-of-range values before building a transaction. Admin-only;
the caller's wallet is the transaction source/signer.
Error code references: `AUTH_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

feeBps.description: New platform fee rate in basis points.
